items.title: An abstract Bakry–Émery gradient-contraction adapter

source.edition: Chewi, An Introduction to Sampling, edition 2026-08-09
source.anchor: Definitions 1.2.28–1.2.29 and the standard backward-interpolation argument
source.attribution: Samplinglib-authored abstract composition of Chewi's carré-du-champ curvature setup with positive linear evolution and scalar Grönwall.

items.statement: A positive linear evolution satisfying the standard backward interpolation derivative identity contracts the carré-du-champ interpolation at rate 2α under the fully expanded CD(α,∞) inequality.
assumptions: The fully expanded curvature inequality with α>0.
A real-linear pointwise-order-preserving evolution at every real time.
Continuity and the exact right derivative identity for the selected interpolation.

obligations.label: Compose curvature, positivity, the exact derivative identity, and scalar comparison

bindings.boundary: A concrete semigroup must still prove positivity, continuity, its interpolation derivative identity, and generator-domain closure.

assumption_deltas.source: The textbook method uses a concrete Markov semigroup and its backward interpolation.
assumption_deltas.lean: Samplinglib abstracts only the properties consumed by the proof: real-linearity, pointwise order preservation, continuity, and the exact one-sided derivative identity.
assumption_deltas.reason: The abstraction exposes the analytic interface without claiming construction of a concrete semigroup.
